More About This Super C The Isata 5 is Dynamax's flagship Super C, and this 28SS Extreme Edition is the most capable version of it. Built on a factory 4x4 Ram 5500 chassis with a 6.7L Cummins turbo diesel (360HP / 800 lb-ft) and an Aisin six-speed automatic, it pairs go-anywhere traction with the exhaust-brake control and adaptive cruise you want for confident travel days. The DynaRide+ suspension with Bilstein shocks and MORryde rear springs smooths out the road, while the Xplorer Package adds dual-pane frameless windows, four lithium house batteries (400aH), a 1,000W solar package, and an insulated, heated utility bay for true off-grid capability. Inside, the single-slide 28SS floorplan delivers a residential feel in a 31-foot footprint, with dual power theater seats, a full galley, and premium finishes throughout.
